parameters.query: SELECT params->'ALLOWED_APPS' AS allowed FROM automation.profile_state WHERE name = 'app-allowlist'

WITH done AS (
  UPDATE automation.setting s
  SET value = 'fertig:' || now()::text, updated_at = now()
  FROM public.command_results r
  WHERE s.key LIKE 'aufraeumen:%' AND s.value LIKE 'inventur:%'
    AND r.id = substring(s.key from 12) AND r.command_uuid = substring(s.value from 10)
    AND r.status IN ('Acknowledged', 'Error', 'CommandFormatError')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM automation.profile_state p WHERE p.name = 'app-allowlist' AND p.params->'ALLOWED_APPS' @> '["com.apple.Preferences","com.apple.AppStore"]'::jsonb)
  RETURNING substring(s.key from 12) AS enrollment_id, r.status, r.result
)
SELECT done.enrollment_id, done.status, done.result, d.serial_number FROM done JOIN public.enrollments e ON e.id = done.enrollment_id JOIN public.devices d ON d.id = e.device_id

meta.description: Alle 5 Minuten: holt, falls ueber das Formular eine Inventur angefordert wurde, die Antworten auf InstalledApplicationList (nanomdm command_results), vergleicht mit der Erlaubt-Liste (Profil app-allowlist: Systemapps plus Katalog) und reiht fuer alles Uebrige RemoveApplication ein. Das Ergebnis geht per ntfy an Home-Lab-MDM. Bricht ab, wenn die Erlaubt-Liste leer oder unvollstaendig ist. Credentials: MDM Automation DB, MDM NanoMDM API, ntfy-publisher.
